receptor_decay: Exact exponential exp(-1/tau) per synapse, applied before arrival events; neuron RK substeps do not refine synaptic clock.
TM: At each tick recover u*=exp(-1/tau_f), x=1-(1-x)*exp(-1/tau_r); at arrival u+=U*(1-u), release=u*x/U, then x-=u*x. Start u=0,x=1. Fixed delays translate arrival times. Static release is 1 and preserves first impulse.
rise: For tau_r>0, impulse adds equal scaled rise and decay states, effective g=d-r. Continuous analytical peak normalization retained; discrete sampled peak need not equal 1. Instantaneous rise contributes only decay state even alongside rising connections.
comparison: Actual CARLsim CPU and GPU public conductance readbacks against independently authored Python float64 analytical convolution and TM recurrence; CPU/GPU agreement is secondary.
biology_gate: All independent backend cases pass before calibration; complete coverage, eligibility and numerical pass required for setup success. Retain all failures.
timestamp_convention: Readback indexed by integration tick t after runNetwork(0,1). CARLsim delay 1 arrives during emission tick; arrival readback index is emission+delay-1 (effective wall boundary emission+delay). Event at t=0 is included.
